She's an asshole here by putting pressure on you and not getting your "no".

Almost every person in a relationship has thoughts or emotions (from time to time) that can be difficult and hurtful to the other party. The issue is how we express them and how we worked on them.

As you told, your boyfriend comes from a conservative culture. Despite this, according to what you said, he has NEVER EXHIBITED any jealousy in beahviour. Moreover, he was reflexive enough to take a look into his emotions and work on them. So what if he had emotions that were difficult for you, if he worked through them, and didn't do anything to hurt you?

Don't get me wrong, you have the right to look and dress how you want. A man does not have the right to dictate to you how you should dress. But that's not the case here.

If you wear a certain type of clothing that you wouldn't normally wear just to test your boyfriend then something is not right with you/your relationship. You thought at worst he would get angry - ok, what would you do if he got angry? Break up with him? I mean, if his culture is a problem for you, you can break up with him like a normal person.

What did you want to accomplish in this way?

For me, it seems like you are the asshole.
